description: This file defines error handling and validation error types and functions for schema validation in the k8s.io/kube-openapi project, including error message templates, error codes, and validation error constructors.

methods.name: Code
methods.description: Returns the error code for CompositeError.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the CompositeError, including nested errors.

methods.name: CompositeValidationError
methods.description: Creates a new CompositeError grouping multiple validation errors.

methods.name: FailedAllPatternProperties
methods.description: Creates a validation error indicating a property failed all pattern properties.

methods.name: PropertyNotAllowed
methods.description: Creates a validation error indicating a property is not allowed.

methods.name: TooFewProperties
methods.description: Creates a validation error for an object with too few properties.

methods.name: TooManyProperties
methods.description: Creates a validation error for an object with too many properties.

methods.name: AdditionalItemsNotAllowed
methods.description: Creates a validation error for additional items not allowed.

methods.name: InvalidCollectionFormat
methods.description: Creates a validation error for unsupported collection format.

methods.name: InvalidTypeName
methods.description: Creates a validation error for an invalid type name.

methods.name: InvalidType
methods.description: Creates a validation error for an invalid type with detailed message.

methods.name: DuplicateItems
methods.description: Creates a validation error for duplicate array items.

methods.name: TooManyItems
methods.description: Creates a validation error for too many items in an array.

methods.name: TooFewItems
methods.description: Creates a validation error for too few items in an array.

methods.name: ExceedsMaximumInt
methods.description: Creates a validation error for exceeding maximum integer value.

methods.name: ExceedsMaximumUint
methods.description: Creates a validation error for exceeding maximum unsigned integer value.

methods.name: ExceedsMaximum
methods.description: Creates a validation error for exceeding maximum float value.

methods.name: ExceedsMinimumInt
methods.description: Creates a validation error for below minimum integer value.

methods.name: ExceedsMinimumUint
methods.description: Creates a validation error for below minimum unsigned integer value.

methods.name: ExceedsMinimum
methods.description: Creates a validation error for below minimum float value.

methods.name: NotMultipleOf
methods.description: Creates a validation error for a value not being a multiple of a specified number.

methods.name: EnumFail
methods.description: Creates a validation error for a value not in the allowed enum.

methods.name: Required
methods.description: Creates a validation error for a missing required value.

methods.name: TooLong
methods.description: Creates a validation error for a string exceeding max length.

methods.name: TooShort
methods.description: Creates a validation error for a string below min length.

methods.name: FailedPattern
methods.description: Creates a validation error for a string not matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: MultipleOfMustBePositive
methods.description: Creates a validation error when multipleOf factor is negative.
